thread:
jia: FYI new canary for asterion24b (int4) is flapping on Dedicated — seeing OOMs once batch >= 8 with default max_new_tokens=512. Posting quick repro notes.
ml-onboard-bot: Canary created: canary/asterion24b-int4/2026-03-21 — 6 pods in eu-west-1
oliver: Can you repro on a single pod? If yes try batch=4 and max_new_tokens=256 first. Also toggle kv_prefetch=false to rule out prefetch spikes.
jia: Reproduced on pod-9 with stress harness. batch=4 + max_new_tokens=256 + kv_prefetch=false stops OOMs but p50 latency +25ms. Allocator histogram still shows many tiny free slots from KV churn.
rachel: Try nudging the slot compactor earlier and reserve a couple slots. Quick suggestion: 
``nserving.runtime.compactor.threshold=0.6
serving.runtime.compactor.reserve_slots=2
serving.runtime.batch.steady=4
serving.runtime.batch.max=6
```
sam: Also consider a soft per-route max_new_tokens default so text routes stay conservative but code-gen can request longer gens.
jia: Pushed compactor + batch changes to canary pod-9 and re-ran stress: no OOMs, fragmentation histogram tighter, tail latency still ~+18ms vs int8 baseline. Current canary config: 
``nmodel: asterion24b-int4
batch:
  steady: 4
  max: 6
max_new_tokens: 256
kv_prefetch: false
compactor:
  threshold: 0.6
  reserve_slots: 2
```
oliver: Good start. Run eval decks: prod-latency-bench, code-gen-small, convo-short. If code-gen quality regresses, fallback that route to int8. Add long-context prompts to stress prefix KV.
sam: Kicked off evals against our int8 baseline (marlinx9b-int8). code-gen-small should finish in ~20m. Added long-context templates.
ml-onboard-bot: Eval job started: eval-run/asterion24b/2026-03-21-1
deploy-bot: Patch deployed to pod-9 with compactor/batch toggles
jia: Early eval notes: convo-short tail latency slightly better, code-gen-small shows ~4% perplexity bump and a couple of tokenization mismatches — likely quant noise in some FF layers.
oliver: For that pattern try per-channel quant calibration and a tiny bias-correction pass on suspect layers. Also flag failing prompts for gradient-free recalibration tests.
rachel: If per-channel calibration helps we can bake it into int4 calibrations. Otherwise plan: serve int4 for text routes with tuned defaults and pin an int8 variant for code-gen until quality parity.
jia: Plan: 1) keep int4 canary config for text routes, 2) spin int8 canary for code-gen routes, 3) queue per-channel calibrate job for int4. Opening PR with compactor change + route-level max_new_tokens + rollout policy and will attach allocator dumps and perf dive.
sam: Please attach eval diffs and allocator histograms to the PR. I'll track metrics and own follow-up.
jia: Will do. Leaving canary under watch for 4h then decide promotion. cc: oliver, rachel, sam :eyes:
